newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain pegged at 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain pegged at 20 pct.

text.p: Pakistan interbank overnight rates remained pegged at 20 percent on Saturday in the liquidity-short banking system, dealers said.
Early trades took place at 20 percent, one dealer of Khadim Ali Shah Bukhari & Co Ltd said.
The rates had not eased due to the settlement of the last auction of short term federal bonds, the dealer said. He could not give the settlement amount.
One week lenders remained adamant at 20 percent but borrowers showed reluctance at this level, he said.
